io_io_serdes_2_u_io_serdes_2: 8.740 W -- SerDes 12 lanes = 2 x 4.37 W per active 6-lane 112G macro (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS SER.MACRO6_POWER)
io_io_serdes_1_u_io_serdes_1: 8.740 W -- SerDes 12 lanes = 2 x 4.37 W per active 6-lane 112G macro (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS SER.MACRO6_POWER)
io_io_serdes_u_io_serdes_1: 8.740 W -- SerDes 12 lanes = 2 x 4.37 W per active 6-lane 112G macro (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS SER.MACRO6_POWER)
io_ucie_kv_u_ucie_kv: 2.458 W -- UCIe x64: 128 lanes x 32 GT/s x 0.6 pJ/b = 2.46 W (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS UCIE.ENERGY, UCIe-A upper; UCIE.RATE 32 GT/s)
io_coll_ucie_u_io_ucie: 2.458 W -- UCIe x64: 128 lanes x 32 GT/s x 0.6 pJ/b = 2.46 W (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS UCIE.ENERGY, UCIe-A upper; UCIE.RATE 32 GT/s)
channels (die.channels): bump keep-out, no logic -> 0 W; whitespace between partitions -> 0 W
PHY windows: no core bumps (die_trial.bump_grid excludes IO windows); PHY supply on core VDD (no die.pg.domains on this plan)
VDD 0.7 V; IR budget 0.05 x VDD = 35.0 mV per region (VDD net, ideal bump sources, as PDNSim)
core C4 power bumps: die_trial.bump_grid pitch 150 um, VDD/VSS by parity, none in IO windows / channels
PHY windows: ASSUMPTION their own PG micro-bumps (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS bump contract 1-3, BUMP.UBUMP 45 um) at PG share UCIe 0.30 (UCIE.A.PG_SHARE) / SerDes + HBM 0.45 (UCIE.S.PG_SHARE as nearest published proxy) -> VDD/VSS lattice 82.158 / 67.082 um; the plan's 150-um window sites are all signal
metal: ASAP7 setRC M8 0.3379 / M9 0.3558 ohm/sq (per-um R x 0.04-um min width); vias ignored
stripes 0.48 um (below the 0.5-um wide-spacing step), VDD at pitch/2, VSS at pitch, die-wide (schema die.pg.grid has no region-limited stripes)
tracks taken: track centre closer than stripe half-width + SPACINGTABLE spacing + half min width, on the P.layers track lattice
IR model: coarse anisotropic FD on the bump lattice (h = pitch/2) + periodic exact-stripe unit cell correction
gate: all (every region)
candidate_assumptions: C4escape130um withinpublished100-150umrange; coordinator approved exploratorycandidate, no adoption
M8pitch2.16um instead2.88; M9unchanged1.728; no power or IRbudget relaxation

core.peak_activity: ar_batch1 die_w_at_design_rate 618.55 W = the full-rate static schedule at 100% issue, UNCAPPED (results/arch/power_scenarios.json A_measured_implementation.qwen3_8b_rom_8k)
core.margin: x1.303 over the 474.56 W liquid-cooling cap the die can sustain (0.5823 W/mm2, the density used by every earlier QC coupon); dflash 1116 W design rate is 2.35x the cap and cannot be issued by the static schedule (excluded, recorded)
core.per_type: one density for every core type: no per-type measured power exists yet; the uncapped design-rate density is applied to every partition (hottest-type density <= die design-rate average is an ASSUMPTION to replace with per-type power when the kits report it)

ucie.peak_activity: UCIe x64: 128 lanes (64 TX + 64 RX) x 32 GT/s x 0.6 pJ/b, all lanes toggling at full rate (PHY_ASSUMPTIONS UCIE.ENERGY upper end, UCIE.RATE 32 GT/s)
ucie.margin: x1.0: 0.6 pJ/b is already the published UPPER energy at the maximum rate; no idle/low-power credit
ucie.distribution: uniform over the full 777.6 x 777.6 um PHY footprint (no AFE-only credit)

serdes.note: PHY_ASSUMPTIONS SER.MACRO6_POWER published 4.37 W per active 6-lane macro; 3 SerDes windows NOT run in this pass

ir_scope: native PDNSim coupons (core_centre 864 um, UCIe window) at WORST_CASE power; VDD/VDDPHY nets; 3 SerDes + coll_ucie windows not run (coll_ucie = same PHY/template)
